title: Unit Event — The First Concerto — Episode6 My Albatross

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD each contend with the missions Ken has assigned them, with their sights on the day they surpass RAD WEEKEND. Toya's task is to write every track they're going to use for their event, and he attempts to pour everything into a song, but that's easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't seem like you want to talk about whatever this subject matter is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if that's what's keeping you from completing your song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Think about everything that I've experienced until now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I started playing the piano when I was three.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't have many clear memories from back then, but I do remember the sounds I heard...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I could only play simple notes using the keys, but Dad just gently pressed down on one and...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't think I'm ever going to forget what I heard for as long as I live. It was such a beautiful sound. Like a gentle breeze causing light to poke through the leaves of a tree...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It was such a strange sensation...
We were playing the same piano, but producing such different sounds.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So strange that I wanted to keep playing it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wanted to learn how to do what Dad did.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That was how I first began playing music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It was also the beginning of some very difficult times...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
No, again.
Don't think you're going to bed before you get it right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I knew that since I'd already seen the way his practices with my brothers went.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I wasn't expecting him to be that hard on me. Even now, whenever I find myself in front of a piano, that anxiety comes rushing back.)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But you shouldn't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: The world of music is vast and endless. It's much bigger than you realize.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: But you may someday come to understand why that is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not only was that the first time he ever praised me, but he said I have a chance to understand the truth someday.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I wanted to meet his expectations.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But as time went on, my fingers started feeling heavier and heavier.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Endless practices day after day.
The immense pressure of having to perform well during contests. And...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I practice every single day in the same room. I'm not allowed to do anything else...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I know you have high expectations of me, Dad. I know why you're asking so much of me.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Is this really it for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You're going to throw away everything you've worked for just like that?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line:
What...?
What do you know about me?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: It's my life! I want to live it the way I want!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line:
I want to do what other people do!
I want to experience as many new things as I can! That's all...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Toya
rows.Line: I'm sick of being stuck in this room...!!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I ran and dashed all of Dad's hopes for me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Some have told me that it doesn't count as running...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I thought I would see classical music through a positive lens by now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the pain I felt back then keeps me from doing so...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it causing me to think, “I can't”...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I ran and tossed aside something that meant everything to me... I've given up once already, so there's no reason I'd ever be able to match Ken and his team's resolve...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Have I been feeling that subconsciously...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That would give Dad's words so much more meaning...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I... I've been viewing myself as someone who ran away. Someone who lacks pride....)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm struggling to write a good song...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's why I can't commit to it like Ken and his team did with theirs...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I still have to do this...!
I have to make these songs so that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND together!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And I can't just get rid of these feelings that are weighing me down...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why did I decide to run away that day...?!

What's going on?
Why are you shouting?
